description:
## Why

Empirical finding from PKIX-lwr9.1 (2026-05-11): of the 25 bettertls::pathbuilding fixtures imported into pkix-path-builder/tests/bettertls.rs, **23 of 25 already pass** end-to-end when routed through pkix_path_builder::build_path. Only tc60 is a genuine builder bug.

Root cause of the 47-case StricterThanWild figure in baseline-limbo.json: pkix-difftest/src/corpus/limbo.rs::build_item constructs positional chains `[peer, ..intermediates, anchor]` and feeds them DIRECTLY to pkix_path::validate_path, BYPASSING pkix-path-builder. PKIX-yn3e (AKI-based candidate selection, 2026-05-08) shipped before the limbo baseline was generated, but the limbo harness has never invoked the builder.

## What

Update pkix-difftest/src/corpus/limbo.rs::build_item (or wherever the CertPath classification path lives) to:

1. Construct a cert bundle from the testcase's peer + intermediates + trust anchors
2. Call pkix_path_builder::build_path to produce the ordered chain
3. Feed the builder-produced chain to pkix_path::validate_path for classification
4. Fall back to the current positional-chain behavior only if build_path fails to find any candidate

This mirrors PKIX-t0w4's PKITS harness change.

## Acceptance

- [ ] limbo harness routes through pkix-path-builder for chain construction
- [ ] Re-run `cargo run --release -p pkix-difftest -- run limbo ~/GIT/x509-limbo/limbo.json --oracles pkix-path,openssl,pyca --output-md pkix-difftest/baseline-limbo.md --output-json pkix-difftest/baseline-limbo.json`
- [ ] StricterThanWild count drops from 74 toward ~30 (empirical bettertls finding suggests most pathbuilding cases flip to Agreement)
- [ ] Update pkix-difftest/baseline-limbo-analysis.md with new bucket counts and residual divergences
- [ ] Residual divergences (genuine builder bugs like tc60) are filed as follow-ups against PKIX-lwr9.2/.3/.4 — those children are reframed/closed based on what actually remains

## Out of scope

- Implementing new RFC 4158 path-building heuristics (deferred to PKIX-lwr9.2/.3/.4 IF they survive the re-baseline)
- The 2 tc8/tc15 cases (legacy ECDSA OID harness limitation, not path-builder)
- online::* cases (P-384 harness limitation, PKIX-wmch)

## Filed by

Decision recorded 2026-05-11 on PKIX-lwr9: pick option (a) — wire pkix-path-builder into the limbo harness before working .2/.3/.4. Residual builder bugs (if any) become the actual .2/.3/.4 scope.

## Refs

- pkix-difftest/src/corpus/limbo.rs::build_item
- pkix-path-builder/tests/bettertls.rs (characterization harness from .1)
- PKIX-t0w4 (PKITS analog of this change, closed)
- PKIX-yn3e (AKI candidate selection, shipped pre-baseline)
title: pkix-difftest: route limbo CertPath bundles through pkix-path-builder before classification
